text: On 13 April 2009, two Domino’s Pizza employees filmed the preparation of pizzas for delivery violating health-code standards. They posted the video clip online. Next day it became viral. As the company learnt about the video on the day it was posted, Tim McIntyre, Vice President of Communications at Domino’s Pizza, said that executives decided to turn a blind eye to this video thinking it to be the “video of the moment in the cyber space”. He said that we missed the mushrooming effect of viral sensations”.
